messages.text:
Is there someone i can get in contact id like to make changes to an order of
mine.

Hi there,

Yes, you can make changes right here. Just reply to this email. I can update most orders myself, including the shipping address and switching to a different product, as long as the order hasn't shipped yet.

To find your order, please send me your order number (it looks like Shop····) and one detail on it, such as the name it ships to or the postcode. Also tell me what you'd like to change.

If you'd still prefer to speak with someone on the team, say so in your reply and I'll pass it on with your details.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support

Hi,

You're welcome. Your order Shop···· is paused, so nothing will ship while this is being looked at. Paying by credit card won't cause any problem.

A colleague will pick this up today after 10am ET, and the answer will come to this email. It will help if you reply with the product you'd like instead and how many. That way they can give you the exact figures in the same reply.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support
